decisive_items: bilateral nonpurulent conjunctivitis, erythematous throat, palmar erythema, a strawberry tongue, and an erythema multiforme–type rash
response.rationale: R3 is the only candidate with a composite of specific Kawasaki mucocutaneous findings plus fever and marked inflammation, and it has no raw contradictions. R1 shares only abdominal pain, rash, and conjunctivitis, and its raw contradiction of negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR weakens it; R2 and R4 lack the characteristic mucocutaneous pattern.

rejected.why: Raw support is limited to abdominal pain, rash, and conjunctivitis, and it carries a raw contradiction of negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR; the full Kawasaki-like mucocutaneous composite is absent.
Only intermittent fever, abdominal pain, and rash are raw supports; no quotidian fever, arthritis, or other sJIA-defining features are present.

Only fever and erythematous throat are raw supports; no lymphocytosis, atypical lymphocytes, splenomegaly, or positive heterophile/Monospot is present, and negative blood cultures do not support mononucleosis.
